{
  "proposal_id": "mana-core-next-three-devstral-small-001",
  "tasks": [
    {
      "id": "mana-core-gradient-calculator-devstral-001",
      "title": "Implement GradientCalculator for mana flow direction and intensity",
      "objective": "Create pure-Java class that calculates mana gradients between coordinates using the completed ChunkManaMap storage slice. Must compute direction and magnitude of mana flow from high to low concentration.",
      "depends_on": ["mana-core-storage-implementation-devstral-tools"],
      "allowed_files": [
        "src/main/java/com/manacore/core/flow/GradientCalculator.java",
        "src/test/java/com/manacore/core/flow/GradientCalculatorTest.java"
      ],
      "forbidden_files": [
        "src/main/java/com/manacore/core/storage/ChunkManaMap.java",
        "src/main/java/com/manacore/core/storage/ManaCoordinates.java",
        "src/main/java/com/manacore/core/ManaMath.java",
        "src/test/java/com/manacore/core/storage/ChunkManaMapTest.java",
        "src/main/java/com/manacore/core/flow/FlowEngine.java",
        "src/main/java/com/manacore/core/gather/SphericalGatherer.java",
        "docs/PRODUCT.md",
        "docs/ARCHITECTURE.md",
        "mod-spec.json",
        "AGENTS.md"
      ],
      "constraints": "Pure Java implementation. No Minecraft or Fabric API classes. Must use only public methods of ChunkManaMap, ManaCoordinates, and ManaMath. No modifications to storage slice or any file outside allowed_files. No network or file I/O. All Gradle, asset, client, API, networking, config, block, and entity files are forbidden.",
      "client_server_considerations": "Server-only logic. No imports from net.minecraft.client.* or com.manacore.client.*. Must be usable in headless server environment.",
      "acceptance_criteria": "GradientCalculator.java compiles without errors. GradientCalculatorTest.java passes all assertions. Correctly computes gradient vector between any two valid ManaCoordinates. Handles edge cases: same coordinate returns zero vector, out-of-bounds coordinates throw appropriate exceptions.",
      "files_to_inspect": [
        "src/main/java/com/manacore/core/storage/ChunkManaMap.java",
        "src/main/java/com/manacore/core/storage/ManaCoordinates.java",
        "src/main/java/com/manacore/core/ManaMath.java"
      ],
      "suggested_write_roots": [
        "src/main/java/com/manacore/core/flow/",
        "src/test/java/com/manacore/core/flow/"
      ],
      "suggested_verifiers": ["compile-common", "unit-tests"],
      "rationale": "Gradient calculation is the foundational mathematics for mana flow. The storage slice provides coordinate-based mana values; GradientCalculator computes the direction and intensity of flow between them. Without this, FlowEngine cannot determine how mana should move. This is a pure logic component with no Minecraft dependencies, making it ideal for isolated implementation and testing. Enables the 'Mana Flows' core loop element."
    },
    {
      "id": "mana-core-flow-engine-devstral-002",
      "title": "Implement FlowEngine for mana movement orchestration",
      "objective": "Create the orchestration layer that applies gradient calculations to move mana values between coordinates. Must iterate over loaded chunks, compute gradients, and transfer mana while preserving total mana quantity (conservation law).",
      "depends_on": [
        "mana-core-storage-implementation-devstral-tools",
        "mana-core-gradient-calculator-devstral-001"
      ],
      "allowed_files": [
        "src/main/java/com/manacore/core/flow/FlowEngine.java",
        "src/test/java/com/manacore/core/flow/FlowEngineTest.java"
      ],
      "forbidden_files": [
        "src/main/java/com/manacore/core/storage/ChunkManaMap.java",
        "src/main/java/com/manacore/core/storage/ManaCoordinates.java",
        "src/main/java/com/manacore/core/ManaMath.java",
        "src/test/java/com/manacore/core/storage/ChunkManaMapTest.java",
        "src/main/java/com/manacore/core/flow/GradientCalculator.java",
        "src/main/java/com/manacore/core/gather/SphericalGatherer.java",
        "docs/PRODUCT.md",
        "docs/ARCHITECTURE.md",
        "mod-spec.json",
        "AGENTS.md"
      ],
      "constraints": "Must use GradientCalculator for all gradient computations. Must use ChunkManaMap for all storage access. Must preserve mana conservation: sum of all mana values before and after flow operation must be equal (modulo floating-point precision). No Minecraft classes in core flow logic. No modifications to storage slice, GradientCalculator, or any file outside allowed_files. All Gradle, asset, client, API, networking, config, block, and entity files are forbidden.",
      "client_server_considerations": "Server-only logic. No client imports. Must be thread-safe or clearly document thread-safety assumptions for server tick usage.",
      "acceptance_criteria": "FlowEngine.java compiles without errors. FlowEngineTest.java passes all assertions. Correctly moves mana from high-concentration to low-concentration coordinates. Preserves mana conservation across flow operations. Handles edge cases: empty chunks, single-coordinate chunks, world boundaries.",
      "files_to_inspect": [
        "src/main/java/com/manacore/core/storage/ChunkManaMap.java",
        "src/main/java/com/manacore/core/storage/ManaCoordinates.java",
        "src/main/java/com/manacore/core/ManaMath.java",
        "src/main/java/com/manacore/core/flow/GradientCalculator.java"
      ],
      "suggested_write_roots": [
        "src/main/java/com/manacore/core/flow/",
        "src/test/java/com/manacore/core/flow/"
      ],
      "suggested_verifiers": ["compile-common", "unit-tests"],
      "rationale": "FlowEngine is the core mechanism that animates the mana system. It depends on GradientCalculator to determine flow direction and ChunkManaMap for persistence. Implementing this after GradientCalculator respects the dependency order: foundation (storage) -> calculation (gradient) -> orchestration (flow). Mana conservation is critical for system stability and must be enforced from the start. Directly implements the 'Mana Flows' core loop element."
    },
    {
      "id": "mana-core-spherical-gatherer-devstral-003",
      "title": "Implement SphericalGatherer for mana collection from spherical regions",
      "objective": "Create the system that collects mana from a spherical region around a consumer point into a target storage. Must implement efficient spherical iteration and mana transfer with configurable radius.",
      "depends_on": ["mana-core-storage-implementation-devstral-tools"],
      "allowed_files": [
        "src/main/java/com/manacore/core/gather/SphericalGatherer.java",
        "src/test/java/com/manacore/core/gather/SphericalGathererTest.java"
      ],
      "forbidden_files": [
        "src/main/java/com/manacore/core/storage/ChunkManaMap.java",
        "src/main/java/com/manacore/core/storage/ManaCoordinates.java",
        "src/main/java/com/manacore/core/ManaMath.java",
        "src/test/java/com/manacore/core/storage/ChunkManaMapTest.java",
        "src/main/java/com/manacore/core/flow/GradientCalculator.java",
        "src/main/java/com/manacore/core/flow/FlowEngine.java",
        "docs/PRODUCT.md",
        "docs/ARCHITECTURE.md",
        "mod-spec.json",
        "AGENTS.md"
      ],
      "constraints": "Must use ChunkManaMap for all storage access. Spherical region must be defined by configurable radius. Must handle partial spheres at world boundaries. Must not modify coordinates outside the spherical region. No Minecraft classes in core logic. No modifications to storage slice, flow system, or any file outside allowed_files. All Gradle, asset, client, API, networking, config, block, and entity files are forbidden.",
      "client_server_considerations": "Server-only logic. No client imports. Gathering operations must be atomic with respect to the mana storage to prevent race conditions with concurrent flow operations.",
      "acceptance_criteria": "SphericalGatherer.java compiles without errors. SphericalGathererTest.java passes all assertions. Correctly iterates over all coordinates in a sphere of given radius. Correctly transfers mana from sphere coordinates to target. Handles edge cases: radius zero, coordinates at world edges, empty spheres.",
      "files_to_inspect": [
        "src/main/java/com/manacore/core/storage/ChunkManaMap.java",
        "src/main/java/com/manacore/core/storage/ManaCoordinates.java",
        "src/main/java/com/manacore/core/ManaMath.java"
      ],
      "suggested_write_roots": [
        "src/main/java/com/manacore/core/gather/",
        "src/test/java/com/manacore/core/gather/"
      ],
      "suggested_verifiers": ["compile-common", "unit-tests"],
      "rationale": "Spherical gathering is a core mechanic from PRODUCT.md: 'Consumer blocks and entities collect mana from spherical regions around them'. This implements the collection side of the mana system independently of flow once storage exists. Together with storage (done), flow (task 2), and gathering (task 3), this completes the minimal core mechanics triad required for the MVP loop."
    }
  ]
}
